Finding.description:
What a rule found wrong in a part: the text at fault, and its line
when it has one.

line.description: The line of the part the text starts on.

pattern.description: The expression that matched, when its rule shows it.

rewrite.description: How to rewrite the text, from a judged rule.

text.description: The text at fault: a match, a budget's count, or a quoted sentence.

Verdict.description:
One rule's verdict on one part, as `rules.evaluate` gave it, with each
null left out. A crossing written before the rename names the rule's
path `control` and its checker `rule`; [`verdicts`] reads both forms, and
[`evaluated`] only the current one.

rule.description: The kind of the rule's checker; left out for a written requirement.

checker.description: The kind of the rule's checker; left out for a written requirement.

findings.description: What the rule found wrong, at most 20.

omitted.description: How many findings were left out past the first 20.

rule.description: The rule's path; before the rename, its checker.

status.description: passed, failed, skipped after a free rule failed, or stated.

description:
`boundary/crossing/v1`: the verdicts on one content, at
`/crossings/<hex>` in the personal board, where `<hex>` is its digest
without `sha256:`.

action.description: The capability that sends the parts, such as github.pr-create.

boundaries.description: The boundaries that matched, by their paths.

digest.description: The digest of the content's action, destination and parts.

from.description:
The checkout the parts leave, by its path in the personal board; left
out when the check named none.

override.description:
The id of the owner's approved effect that let this content through
its failed checks.

result.description: What the destination returned, such as a URL.

to.description: Where the parts go, such as github:octo/board.

verdicts.description: Each check's verdict on each part it applies to.

title: CrossingRecord
